title: pcs.v2 shared schema definitions
description: Shared definitions for the pcs.v2 minimal DTOs. Authority: historical architecture appendix J.1-J.5 (baseline PCS-2026-10-17-r3). This file is a library of $defs, not a DTO with its own golden vectors.

uuid.description: Canonical lower-case UUID text form (8-4-4-4-12). The version nibble is deliberately not restricted so future UUIDv7 identifiers remain representable.

namespace.description: Single-namespace identifier such as example.private (J.2, section 5.3).

timestamp_utc.description: UTC / RFC 3339 instant (section 5.3). The pattern checks syntactic shape only; calendar correctness beyond month/day ranges is semantic.

nullable_timestamp_utc.description: An unknown observation time is null, never invented (J.1).

source_kind.description: Bound by the trusted entry point, never self-declared by a model (J.2).

record_version_int.description: Record version, starting at 1 and increasing (J.1). Bounded by the cross-language safe-integer limit.

state_revision_int.description: Namespace domain-commit sequence (J.1/J.7). Distinct from record_version; the schema only bounds the numeric shape.

scope_id.description: Opaque scope identifier. J.1 does not require these to be UUIDs.

instance_id.description: Stable identifier of the source instance (for example a home or process identity).

source_event_id.description: Source-side event identifier; part of the idempotency key (namespace, source_instance, source_event_id).

event_type.description: Event type label. The set is open; unknown types are not a structural error.

payload_ref.description: Opaque pointer into the controlled private-payload area. J.1-J.5 do not fix its inner scheme.

event_ref.description: Typed reference to an Event (J.1). Bare IDs are not representable.

record_ref.description: Typed reference to an exact Record version (J.1). A RecordRef without record_version is invalid.

any_ref.description: Union of the only two legal reference shapes (J.1). Exactly one branch must match.
